title: Follicle tracking ultrasound
what: The doctor checks your ovaries with ultrasound several times during one cycle. This shows how the follicle grows and whether you ovulated.
why: When planning a pregnancy, with an irregular cycle, during ovulation stimulation, and before IVF.
duration: one visit usually takes 10 to 15 minutes; usually 2 to 4 visits per cycle; results right away
tell_doctor: The first day of your last period
How long your cycle usually is
If you take hormone medicines or ovulation stimulation
If you had surgery on your ovaries or uterus

prepare.title: When to come
prepare.text: The first visit is usually on day 8 to 10 of your cycle. Your doctor will set the days based on your cycle length.

prepare.title: Bladder
prepare.text: Usually an internal probe is used, so your bladder should be empty. Use the toilet before the scan.

prepare.title: Hygiene
prepare.text: A normal shower. No special prep is needed.

bring: Your cycle calendar or an app with your period dates
A sheet and wipes, if the clinic asks
steps: You undress below the waist and lie on the couch
A disposable cover with gel is put on the probe
The probe is gently placed in the vagina
The doctor measures the follicles and the lining of the uterus
You are told when to come for the next visit
feel: If it is uncomfortable, tell the doctor, and they will be gentler
after: You can go back to your usual day right away
You get the result of each visit right away
Afterward, your doctor will suggest the best days to conceive or the next step in treatment

faq.q: How many times do I need to come?
faq.a: Usually 2 to 4 times in one cycle, until it is clear whether you ovulated.
Usually not. You only feel light pressure from the probe.

reminders.text: Follicle tracking scan tomorrow. Use the toilet before the scan. Bring the dates of your last period.
